text: You push open the heavy oak door. It fights you for a moment against the mountain draft before slamming shut behind you, cutting off the howling wind instantly.[p]The silence is immediately replaced by a wall of sound: the clatter of clay cups, the low roar of conversation, and the hiss of a hearth fire. The air is thick, smelling of roasted root-stew, drying mud, and woodsmoke.
You step back into the Windbreak. The warmth hits you like a physical weight, thawing the chill from your bones. The inn is bustling as usual, a sanctuary against the split-howl outside.

The main room is crowded with sturdy wooden tables. Most are occupied by miners and travelers, Monsterfolk of all shapes huddled over bowls of steam. The lighting is warm and orange, cast by oil lamps hanging from low beams reinforced with iron bands and the small hearth at the back of the inn.

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: A rough, barking voice erupts from behind the far counter, shouting over the noise of the crowd:[p]"If that broth boils over again, Kekk, I’m using your face to wipe the floor! Watch the heat!"

It’s a rough place, but built to last. The stone walls are thick, and the windows are small narrow slits, likely to keep the heat in and the wind out. A few Monsterfolk are piled together on a bench near the fire, sipping from clay cups. In a dark corner, a Kraaal is quietly negotiating with a miner over a stack of coins.

A few Monsterfolk are piled together on a bench near the fire, sipping from clay cups. In a dark corner, a toothy Monsterfolk is quietly negotiating with a miner over a stack of coins.

You stand before the main counter. It's a high, slab-wood affair, stained dark by years of spilled ale and elbow grease. Behind it, the entrance to the kitchen radiates heat and the sound of clattering pans.[nb]No one is currently tending the bar, but a heavy, dented iron bell sits near a stack of clean mugs.
You slam your palm down on the iron bell. It lets out a sharp, dull [b]*CLANK*[/b] rather than a ring, a sound that cuts through the ambient noise.

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: You lean against the wood and wait. A few minutes pass. A small furry arm reaches out from the kitchen doorway to grab a stack of bowls, then disappears again. Finally, the barking voice grumbles something about "useless skräp" and footsteps approach.

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: A small mammal stomps out from the kitchen, wiping wet hands on a leather apron that looks like it’s seen better decades. He’s short but ragged, a few scars scattered across his body, a piece of his right ear missing.

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: His oversized ears twitch independently, one of them folded awkwardly at the tip. He doesn't look up immediately, aggressively reorganizing a tray of dried herbs on the counter.[p]"Stew's not ready. Drink's watered down if you're cheap, strong if you're not. And if you make a joke about the name 'Windbreak', you can eat outside with the street creechs."

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: He finally lifts his head, his wide-set eyes narrowing as they land on you. He pauses, his nose twitching once, twice.[p]"...Huh. You're a tall one. And not much fur on you, is there?"

options.text: > I'm just looking for a drink

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: "Ain't we all." He grabs a rag and starts polishing a spot on the counter that looks permanently stained. "Crowns or Öre. Tavo-Pavo don't take promises, and I definitely don't take 'I'll pay you next week'."

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: "Owner, cook, cleaner, bouncer, and accountant." He scratches his floppy ear with his tail. "Name's Tavo-Pavo. Most folks just say Tavo unless they're angry at me."

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: "Obviously. Locals don't stare at the bell like it's a puzzle." He gives a short, chuffing snort. "Well, try not to die in a ditch this week. It's bad for tourism." The mammal quickly wipes the counter with one of his rags. "The name's Tavo-Pavo, owner of this fine establishment called the Windbreak Inn."

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: Tavo leans back, crossing his surprisingly muscular, furry arms over his chest. "So? What can the Windbreak do for you, [b]bolk[/b]?"

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: Tavo gives a grunt and scurries back to the kitchen immediately. "Kekk! If you burned that vitlök I swear to the Howl..."
You return to the counter. Tavo is there, currently counting a small pile of slag-glass öre coins.

name: Tavo-Pavo
text: "Back again?" He doesn't look up from his counting. "Thirsty or hungry?"
